assumptions: Evaluation time 2023-04-02T19:39:06-03:00 (taken as -03:00, the offset used by the export; it equals the latest encounter start). Status: closed = qualifying follow-up at/after the trigger and on/before the deadline; delayed = first qualifying follow-up after the deadline but before evaluation; open = none by evaluation time. "Delayed" uses the first qualifying event at any later date (no upper cap), as the task definition implies.

Obligations whose deadline fell after the patient died, with nothing done before death, are treated as lapsed and listed under "excluded_lapsed", not counted. An open obligation whose deadline passed before death is still counted as open.

Generic lab rules R001/R002 (abnormal), R011 (normal -> provider review), R021 (abnormal after discharge) and R022 (critical value): NOT evaluated. The export has no interpretation flags and no reference ranges on any of 70,233 Observations, and these rules state no threshold, so "abnormal", "normal" and "critical" cannot be determined from the source. The closing events (patient notification, provider acknowledgement, critical-value call documentation) are also never represented. Sensitivity check only: with a common critical-value list, arterial pH 34 results in 5 patients, WBC 4 results in 1 patients would qualify (K, Na, glucose, Hb, platelets and INR never reach critical ranges).

Analyte-specific rules with no stated cut-off use standard clinical thresholds: R004 PSA > 4.0 ng/mL; R012 TSH outside 0.45-4.5 mIU/L; R017 FIT positive at >= 100 ng/mL buffer (the 20 ug Hb/g manufacturer cut-off), so all 5 FITs (1.1-19 ng/mL) are negative; R052 Hb < 13 g/dL (men) or < 12 g/dL (women) plus ferritin < 30 ug/L. Rules that state a threshold use it: R013 HbA1c >= 9 % (max in data 8.2 %, so it never fires), R053 creatinine >= 1.5x baseline and >= 0.3 mg/dL higher, R055 >= 3 RBC/hpf twice (max 2.8/hpf, so it never fires).

R053 baseline follows the NHS England AKI algorithm: the lowest creatinine in the prior 7 days, otherwise the median of the prior 8-365 days. Any later creatinine counts as the repeat. Excluded: patients on maintenance dialysis (any dialysis in the prior 30 days, or dialysis started and no kidney transplant yet). Their creatinine moves with dialysis timing and is not an AKI warning. These alerts are listed as candidates. Rises that appear only when a value from one creatinine assay series is compared against a baseline from the other, discordant series (see data_quality) are also treated as lab artefacts and listed as candidates, not obligations. Only rises within the same series are counted.

R010 "medication change requiring monitoring" = a new start, a dose INCREASE, a formulation/route change, or a restart after > 2 years with no order, for drugs that need early laboratory monitoring: ACE inhibitors, ARBs/ARNI, thiazide and loop diuretics, tacrolimus (renal function/potassium) and cytotoxic chemotherapy (CBC/renal; first cycle only). A repeat prescription of the same drug and dose is NOT a medication change. A dose DECREASE is not counted (26 such orders). Not monitoring drugs for this rule: metformin, statins, insulin, amlodipine, beta-blockers, epoetin (Hb checked monthly per KDIGO, outside 14 d), antibiotics, analgesics. The closing lab must be > 12 h after the order, so the same-visit baseline does not count.

R007 (anticoagulant dose change -> INR) not fired: there is no warfarin/VKA (or DOAC) in the data. The anticoagulants present are parenteral (1 ML heparin sodium, porcine 5000 UNT/ML Injection x3, 0.4 ML Enoxaparin sodium 100 MG/ML Prefilled Syringe x40, 50 ML bivalirudin 5 MG/ML Injection x1) and are not monitored by INR.

Discharge rules: ED and inpatient encounters that overlap or are <= 6 h apart are merged into one episode, and the discharge is the end of the episode. "Hospitalisation" = an episode containing an IMP encounter or lasting >= 24 h. Follow-up appointment = a later AMB/virtual clinician encounter (dental, vaccine-only, dialysis-session and death-certification encounters excluded). No encounter specialty is exported, so "cardiology review" (R014) cannot be verified, and any clinician visit is accepted. The note names the first visit with a cardiac reason.
R014 includes episode c5fd298a (ED diagnosis "Myocardial infarction", inpatient reason "Preinfarction syndrome").

New heart failure (R016): a heart-failure admission in a patient who already has chronic CHF is NOT a new HF diagnosis. In all 5 HF patients the HF Condition began in an outpatient encounter months before the first HF admission, so R016 (trigger = discharge) never fires. The 5 outpatient diagnoses are listed as candidates (all had an echo within 30 d). R023 applies to every HF hospitalisation, including those in known chronic HF.

R024: pre-eclampsia/eclampsia recorded during the pregnancy, with the trigger at discharge from the delivery admission. Eclampsia is a severe hypertensive disorder, so the deadline is 72 h (ACOG). Non-severe pre-eclampsia uses the rule's 10 d. Closure = a blood-pressure panel observation after discharge.

R029 (self-harm/psychiatric discharge) not fired. ED visits for "Overdose" have no coded intent (no self-harm or suicide-attempt code), and drug detoxification admissions are substance-use admissions, not psychiatric admissions. Both are listed as candidates with their would-be status.
Creatinine rise in dialysis patients: not an AKI warning (see R053). Dialysis periods come from Renal dialysis procedures, and a kidney transplant ends the exclusion.

R008: only specialist referrals count (cardiology, cardiac surgery, transplant surgeon, sleep clinic, orthopaedic surgeon, "further care"). Dental-care referrals (699, generated at routine visits), home-health referrals and "Referral for X-ray" (an imaging order) are excluded. Because there are no specialty or referral-appointment links, a referral counts as completed at the first later encounter for the referred problem: cardiology = encounter with a cardiac reason; cardiac surgery = cardiac surgical admission; transplant surgeon = transplant evaluation or admission; generic "further care" = escalation to ED/inpatient within 30 d or a follow-up/consultation encounter. Dialysis sessions never count as a referral visit.

R006/R015 cultures: 2 positive blood cultures (gram-positive, during sepsis admissions) create R015 obligations. R015 closure is judged on the repeat blood culture only, because the callback component does not apply to a patient who is still in hospital. 11 positive urine cultures (E. coli > 100k CFU/mL) were all resulted during the index encounter (issued = collection time), so none is "post-discharge" and R006 never fires.

Not evaluable or no triggers in this export: R005 (Pap smears recorded as procedures with no results), R026 (HCV antibody test procedures with no results), R009 (no pathology reports; prostate biopsies are followed by a carcinoma Condition but no pathology result resource), R025 (no gestational diabetes), R027/R028 (no chronic HBV/cirrhosis), R054 (no atrial fibrillation), all radiology/AI/second-reader rules R003, R018-R020, R030-R047, R056-R058 (no radiology reports: imaging exists only as Procedure codes, and the single imaging ServiceRequest, XR chest "plan" 2011, has no report), and the note-plan rules R048-R051 (templated notes with no forward plans).
R012: TSH 4.60 (patient c5fd298a) qualifies, but the patient died the next day, so it is lapsed. TSH 4.34 (c8f74a4f) is abnormal only with a 4.0 upper limit and is listed as a candidate.

R052: no ferritin < 30 ug/L exists (min 31.4). 12 low-Hb results with ferritin 30-45 ug/L (where BSG 2021 would still investigate) are listed as candidates, all in HF patients during admissions (likely anaemia of chronic disease).
data_quality: HbA1c (4548-4): 558/1067 values < 4.0 % (min 2.43%) - physiologically implausible (HbA1c < 4 % is very rare); max is 8.2 %, so no value reaches the R013 threshold of 9 %
Creatinine (38483-4): 14 values > 20 mg/dL (max 88.9 mg/dL) in 4 patients - implausible even for ESRD (likely unit error, umol/L entered as mg/dL)

Creatinine: two discordant series. "Basic metabolic panel - Blood" (38483-4, no eGFR) runs ~0.4-1.3 mg/dL while "... 2000 panel" results (38483-4/2160-0) run ~1.5-3.2 mg/dL in the same patients, often the same day; 316 timestamps carry two creatinine values differing by >0.3 mg/dL (e.g. 0.69 vs 2.81). The eGFR reported in the 2000 panels does not match its own creatinine (reported/MDRD-computed eGFR ratio 0.3-4.8). Most R053 AKI alerts are produced by switching between these series
hs-Troponin I (89579-7): 94 results labelled pg/mL with values 0.0002-4.9 (would all be below detection if truly pg/mL; magnitude fits ng/mL) and 6 labelled ng/L (6-119) - mixed/likely wrong units
Arterial pH (2744-1): 40 values, range 6.80-7.29, median 7.00; every value is acidaemic and many are < 7.0, implausible as a series in survivors
FIT (57905-2 is a qualitative [Presence] LOINC) carries numeric ng/mL values with no interpretation - code/value-type mismatch

ServiceRequest: 7760 of 7761 are "SARS-CoV-2 RNA" lab orders, one per encounter, all status=completed, 6045 dated before 2020 (test did not exist) and with no matching result - synthetic artefact; they reference non-exported Specimen resources

No referral (ServiceRequest) resources: referrals exist only as Procedure "Referral to ..." codes; no encounter carries a specialty, so referral completion and "cardiology" follow-up can only be inferred from the reason for the next encounter
Labs have no interpretation flags and no referenceRange (0 of 70,233 Observations)

Delivery admissions ("Obstetric emergency hospital admission") last exactly 1 h; prostate biopsy, cancer diagnosis and prostatectomy occur within ~30 min of each other on the same day; eclampsia is diagnosed at a routine prenatal visit with no admission - clinically implausible timelines
HF admissions are each recorded as two overlapping encounters (EMER 1 h + IMP/ICU starting at the same minute); MI as ED encounter + inpatient encounter - merged into one episode for discharge rules

Clinical notes (7,761 DocumentReference + 7,761 identical DiagnosticReport "History and physical note" presentedForm copies) are Synthea templates listing what was done; none contains a forward-looking plan (repeat test / imaging / referral / RTC with an interval), so R048-R051 cannot fire
